validation_scope: Each listed local module was recompiled. Independent import Audit module checked final theorem declarations and their full axiom dependency lists. Existing dependency objects were reused; this is not a fresh source rebuild of the complete transitive dependency closure.
quantified_scope: For positive pairwise-coprime finite P and n>0, empirical signature frequencies of actual integers 1 through n have total L1 error at most M/n from the product Bernoulli weight, M=product of P.
For P containing 2 and 3, Bits(P) is explicitly equivalent to Bool x Bool x Bits(P minus {2,3}); the product weight is exactly SecondSpectral.fullSignatureWeight.
For A contained in [1,n], the class occupancy function f takes values in [0,1]; its product mean and outside mass differ from the actual set density and outside-U density by at most M/n.
The exact dense-card condition implies product mean at least 2/3-(2+M)/n. A real far lower bound delta*n <= outside-card implies delta <= product outside mass + M/n.
provenance: The originally missing Mathlib.Data.Nat.ChineseRemainder object was built with lake build; source unchanged.
No third-party second-question proof was read or imported. Existing local foundational and spectral definitions are reused.

limitations: These modules contain no graph-theoretic far-branch conclusion by themselves.
The independent-triple triangle counting and the spectral/far assembly belong to separate modules.
